references.text: The law forbade touching dead bodies, which made Samson's action of taking honey from the lion carcass unclean
Touching a dead animal made a person unclean, and Samson hid this from his parents
Nazirites were to stay away from dead bodies, but Samson took honey from the lion carcass
Jonathan also found honey in the wild and ate some, just like Samson who found honey in the lion's body
Honey is used as a picture of something sweet and good, just as Samson found the honey sweet to eat
Honey is mentioned as a valuable resource one finds, like the one Samson found in the lion's body
